items.title: Inventory related governance documents and current baseline context
items.context: Read existing decision documents for unattended completion, mid-flight story repair, three-round two-host review escalation, and baseline execution so the new document follows established Lattice conventions.

happy.desc: The resulting roadmap document includes a visible Source And Context Mapping section that inventories all CHK-001 related governance documents and current baseline context, and maps each source to concrete roadmap decisions or sections.

edge.desc: The inventory distinguishes overlapping or potentially conflicting governance concepts such as unattended completion, mid-flight repair, 3-round 2-host escalation, baseline PASS suites, and negative-control BLOCKED suites instead of flattening them into vague citations.

adversarial.desc: A skeptical reader can trace every major source-derived claim in the new document back to the mapping, with no invented runtime behavior, no direct story or fixture file edits, and no missing required source document from the checklist.

items.userSees: The execution document contains a Source And Context Mapping section that shows which existing Lattice documents and baseline facts shaped the roadmap.

verificationEvidence.note: The document includes a visible Source And Context Mapping section that lists the related governance documents and maps each source to roadmap decisions.
The mapping keeps unattended completion, mid-flight repair, 3-round 2-host review, baseline PASS suites, and negative-control BLOCKED suites separate instead of flattening them into vague citations.
Overclaim scan found boundary language such as not implemented runtime behavior, not proof, and future expectations; no direct story/fixture edits were included.

items.title: Write the milestone execution plan for the three strengthening tracks
items.context: Create a detailed requirements decision document that decomposes hard scope boundaries, mechanical evidence chain, and collaboration/preflight controls into executable milestones with deliverables, gates, tests, and sequencing.

happy.desc: The new decision document exists at docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md, is registered in docs/requirements/NAV.md, and decomposes hard scope boundaries, mechanical evidence chain, and collaboration/preflight controls into executable milestones.

edge.desc: Each milestone states deliverables, gates, tests, sequencing, dependencies, expected evidence, blockers, and DONE criteria, including 3-round 2-host validation and baseline or negative-control expectations where the milestone depends on them.

adversarial.desc: The plan does not collapse the three tracks into vague prose, omit cross-track dependencies, or present future gates, baseline suites, or NAV registration as already implemented runtime behavior.

items.userSees: The user can open the roadmap document and see milestone-by-milestone deliverables, gates, tests, dependencies, sequencing, and DONE criteria for strengthening Lattice.

items.title: Verify the document is auditable and does not overclaim implementation
items.context: Review the new document for clear non-goals, milestone DONE criteria, 3-round 2-host decision-doc validation policy, baseline/negative-control expectations, and explicit statement that it is a plan rather than completed runtime behavior.

happy.desc: The completed document has explicit status and non-goals language, milestone DONE criteria, a verification plan, source/context traceability, 3-round 2-host decision-doc validation policy, baseline expectations, and NAV registration verification.

edge.desc: Ambiguous wording such as enforces, blocks, guarantees, passes, or complete is checked so proposed future behavior remains clearly labeled as roadmap work; baseline PASS suites and negative-control BLOCKED suites are described as expectations for future validation rather than proof from this story.

adversarial.desc: A hostile audit cannot find an overclaim that runtime behavior changed, a missing NAV entry for the new decision doc, a missing 3-round 2-host or baseline expectation, or a milestone without auditable acceptance criteria.

items.userSees: The final response can point to the roadmap document and say it is an auditable execution plan, with no claim that runtime gates were already implemented.

auditLog.reason: Source/context mapping verified against the new roadmap document and overclaim scan.
